JSON-friendly alphagraph project model

Source: R/class_project.R
AlphaProject.Rd

Stores a reusable AlphaGraph together with p-value datasets, analysis specifications, optional derived results, project UI state, and metadata. Raw and adjusted p-values deliberately remain outside the graph definition.

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Create an instance with AlphaProject$new(). P-values use stable hypothesis identifiers. Dataset and analysis updates remove affected results; graph replacement removes all results. Use $resultIsCurrent() before displaying a stored result and $validate(requireComputable = TRUE, analysisId = ...) before a calculation. Derived results contain input hashes and engine versions. Mutating methods return the instance invisibly unless stated otherwise.

AlphaProject$new()

Initialize a project containing a graph and empty datasets, analyses, and results.

Usage

AlphaProject$new(
  graph = createDemoAlphaGraph(),
  id = "project",
  label = id,
  description = NULL,
  ui = list(),
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

graph

An AlphaGraph instance; the demo graph is used when omitted at initialization.

id

Character scalar identifying the object within its collection.

label

Human-readable character label.

description

Optional character description; NULL omits it.

ui

Named list of JSON-compatible project UI state; empty by default.

metadata

Named list of JSON-compatible metadata; empty by default.

AlphaProject$upsertAnalysis()

Insert or replace an analysis specification and remove its derived results.

Usage

AlphaProject$upsertAnalysis(
  id,
  datasetId,
  method = c("shortcut", "closure"),
  alpha = 0.025,
  testGroups = list(),
  verbose = FALSE,
  testValues = FALSE,
  label = id,
  description = NULL,
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

id

Character scalar identifying the object within its collection.

datasetId

Character identifier of a p-value dataset.

method

Character choice of "shortcut" or "closure"; only shortcut execution is implemented.

alpha

Numeric significance level in (0, 1]; defaults to 0.025.

testGroups

List of closure groups; empty by default. Each group has hypothesisIds, optional id and label, testType (bonferroni, parametric, simes, or hochberg), and a correlation matrix for parametric tests. Groups must partition the hypotheses.

verbose

Logical passed to graphicalMCP shortcut execution; defaults to FALSE.

testValues

Logical passed as test_values to graphicalMCP; defaults to FALSE.

label

Human-readable character label.

description

Optional character description; NULL omits it.

metadata

Named list of JSON-compatible metadata; empty by default.

AlphaProject$validate()

Validate project structure and optionally computability; return TRUE on success.

Usage

AlphaProject$validate(
  requireComputable = FALSE,
  analysisId = NULL,
  tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
)

Arguments

requireComputable

Logical; whether to require complete numeric inputs for the selected analysis.

analysisId

Character identifier of an analysis specification. Required when requireComputable is TRUE.

tolerance

Numeric validation tolerance; defaults to sqrt(.Machine$double.eps).

AlphaProject$clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

AlphaProject$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

project <- createDemoAlphaProject()
project$pValues("primary")
#> H1_NI  H1_S H2_NI  H2_S 
#> 0.012 0.001 0.030 0.162 
project$validate(requireComputable = TRUE, analysisId = "shortcut-primary")
#> [1] TRUE
